🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 11, swat-bypass — continuation of team-incident-response incident)
Channel: team-incident-response  •  bug-type guess: env  •  alerts in group: 20
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (gateway/auth/identity/search/import-api/tables-fields), `CRM Experience` (ms-scheduler-api), `Transactions` (ms-email-api), `Growth` (signup), `Vertical App Experience` (ms-documents-api)

Symptoms:
  - This is the resolution/continuation of the SQL-cluster c2/c3/c4 error-40 cascade reported earlier today (see docs/investigations/2026-07-06-dd3912b47506342f.md) — DD metric re-query confirms the full lifecycle: ms-authentication-api and gateway errors continuously elevated 01:24Z→~04:21-04:30Z, then cleanly zero through now (11:09Z). ~3h06m total.
  - Blast radius is wider than the original mid-incident snapshot showed: adds gateway 5xx, method-import-api, nonprod/apps, ms-documents-api, tables-fields, ms-scheduler-api, ms-email-api, method-mobile-notifications-api, and — notably — signup (Growth team, unrelated product surface, pre-account flow).
  - Signup fired in the exact same window as this cascade, which supersedes the 2026-07-05 "hold for a second occurrence" note (ki candidate, alert 590dd72178d6d3b8) — working hypothesis is a shared SQL-tier dependency, not an independent signup bug. Signup's Availability SLO monitor (154229727) is still in Alert state (7-day error-budget burn metric, doesn't self-clear on the same timescale as the rest).

Trace IDs: none captured (metric-only re-investigation this cycle, no fresh APM trace pull)
Likely cause: same as the original incident — TCP-reachability loss to SQL clusters c2/c3/c4 (root cause on the SQL/network side still not confirmed by ops)
Suggested next action: ops to confirm SQL/network root cause on clusters c2/c3/c4; once confirmed, finalize kb candidate ki-2026-07-06-sql-cluster-c2c3c4-error40-cascade (proposed, not yet written) — recommend folding signup into that same entry rather than a separate one

Source alerts (20 total):
  • n/a — degraded cycle (no Slack MCP), DD monitor scan sourced; earliest new signal: monitor 299551659 (nonprod/apps 5xx) at 03:16:39Z; last: monitor 154252601 (signup avg latency) at 04:37:41Z

Evidence:
  • DD monitors: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/299544847 — "[Admin][Gateway][P1] 5xx error rate elevated (gateway)" (OK, self-recovered)
  • DD monitors: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/154229727 — "Service Signup Availability SLO" (Alert — still open, error-budget burn metric)
  • DD metric (auth, full lifecycle): https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.aspnet_core.request.errors&exp_scope=env%3Aprod%2Cservice%3Ams-authentication-api&exp_agg=sum&start=1783306800&end=1783317600
  • DD metric (gateway, full lifecycle): https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.aspnet_core.request.errors&exp_scope=env%3Aprod%2Cservice%3Agateway&exp_agg=sum&start=1783299600&end=1783314000
  • DD metric (signup errors): https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.aspnet.request.errors&exp_scope=env%3Aprod%2Cservice%3Asignup&exp_agg=sum&start=1783299600&end=1783314000
